analytical_question: Can the organization proceed from its completed bounded pilot to operational rollout?
general_et_finding: The selected LLM has unmeasured reliability for this task. Generated claims require evaluation.
application_finding: Conditional fit for evidence-linked drafting with buyer verification and manual sourcing decisions. The assistant remains read-only and cannot select suppliers.
organization_specific_finding: Leadership/sponsorship: Strength: charter and delegated authority | Skills/training: Strength: buyers rehearsed verification and escalation | Workflow/process: Strength: manual approval and rehearsed fallback | Infrastructure/data: Strength: approved read-only environment and verified packet identifiers | Resources/budget: Strength for pilot: funded charter and protected review time. Recurring capacity unknown | Governance/risk: Strength for pilot: stop delegation and IT/security escalation | Culture/change: Partial: rehearsal supports error reporting. Sustained uptake unknown | Operating ownership: Strength for pilot: Procurement Operations owns logs and escalation. Sustained ownership unverified. Dominant readiness issue: The pilot met its criteria. Recurring staffing and funding remain unverified.

evidence.claim: The procurement director signed a pilot charter and gave the procurement operations manager authority to stop the pilot. Two buyers completed a source-check and escalation rehearsal, and a category manager signs a manual comparison before any sourcing approval. IT/security approved the read-only sandbox and sanitized data boundary. A procurement analyst checked supplier IDs and revision labels for all 20 historical packets against the approved source. The charter funds sandbox usage and protects four reviewer hours per week. The team tested error reporting and manual fallback in a rehearsal. Procurement Operations owns the pilot log, weekly review, and escalation to IT/security. The charter covers four weeks. Recurring staffing and funding after the pilot have not been decided. The completed pilot met pre-agreed quality and value thresholds. Recurring staffing and funding are still undocumented.
evidence.notes: Readiness judgments are inferences from these stipulated capabilities.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Fictional profile. Assessments were produced in one Codex session. Repeatability and operating outcomes require further evidence.
confidence_and_uncertainty: The stage decision follows the supplied case evidence. Real operating capacity and performance require direct verification.
value_opportunity_implication: Compare buyer effort, review burden and material defects against the manual workflow before extrapolating value.
risk_governance_implication: Retain manual sourcing approval and fallback. Reassess after a material error, loss of authority or a scope change.
recommendation_management_implication: REQUEST EVIDENCE — operational rollout. P0: procurement director and proposed finance partner document recurring staff hours, backup, funding horizon and accountable service ownership. Reassess rollout after approval.
change_monitoring_triggers: On a material missed error or loss of stop coverage, pause and revert to manual review.
Reassess before changing the data scope, reviewer capacity or rollout funding.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Provide the approved recurring staffing and funding plan and named service owner before operational rollout.
